decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD FOR LBC: The works hereby permitted shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 18(1)(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description: Repair of the emergency staircase on the western elevation of the Jenner Building.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
P2025/2970/FUL and P2025/2971/LBC - Retention of the installation of a security gate to the rear staircase and installation of security gate to the top of basement staircase to the rear of the Jenner Building. Awaiting decision.

P2025/0589/FUL and P2025/0591/LBC - Refurbishment works to the basement of the Jenner building including re-opening of windows and the installation of 1no. air handling unit. Approved with conditions 21/10/25.

P2024/0351/FUL and P2024/0380/LBC - Retention of the installation of a security stairgate at the western staircase of the Jenner Building. Approved with conditions 24/07/24.

P2023/0330/LBC - Internal alterations relating to the temporary relocation of the chapel to the former entrance of the Jenner Building. Approved with conditions 30/03/23.
